title: Bijectivity of an existing linear strict-local comparison
statement: Under the hypotheses of the strict-local restriction isomorphism node, the underlying function of the given linear map a is bijective.

source.place: Tag 03Q9, proof, degree-zero comparison and the canonical maps from neighbourhood sections

proof.text: For the adopted full strict-local model, use strictLocalModuleSectionsSetEquiv and its unit/restriction formula. Mathlib sheafFiberCompIso identifies the underlying module stalk with the set stalk compatibly with germ maps.

Apply the official sets_pushforward_stalk_strictHenselization theorem to the underlying set sheaf. Its uniqueness clause identifies the given linear map conjugated by the source and target bijections with its bijective comparison. Cancel the bijections to obtain bijectivity of the given linear map.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03Q9, degree zero; adopted source theorem proof with coefficient and pullback symmetry transport from Tags 03D3 and 03D7

mathlib_searches.query: The stalk of an etale pushforward of a sheaf of modules is the global sections of its pullback to the strict henselization with the canonical germ restriction formula

theorem bijective_qcqsStrictLocalRestriction_of_formula
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (a : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F) ⟶
      (Sheaf.Γ (pullback f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s)).smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
          (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s))).obj F))
    (ha : ∀ j : SmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
      (Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber
        ((Scheme.AffineEtale.Spec Y).obj
          ((equivSmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).1)
        ((equivSmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).2
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F).obj ≫ a =
  ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s))).unit.app F).hom.app
      (op (f.Etale.obj ((Scheme.AffineEtale.Spec Y).obj
        ((equivSmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).1))) ≫
    ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
      (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s))).obj F).obj.map
        (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
    (pullback.lift
      ((pullbackSymmetry f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s)).hom ≫
        Scheme.strictHenselizationBaseChangeMap f s j)
      (𝟙 _)
      (by
        change (pullbackSymmetry f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s)).hom ≫
          Scheme.strictHenselizationBaseChangeMap f s j ≫ pullback.snd _ f = _
        simp only [Scheme.strictHenselizationBaseChangeMap, pullback.lift_snd,
          pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd, Category.id_comp]))
    (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _)).op ≫
    (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections _ _
      (IsTerminal.isTerminalOfObj
        (MorphismProperty.Over.forget @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤
          (pullback f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s)))
        (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 _)) Over.mkIdTerminal)).inv.app _) :
    Function.Bijective (ConcreteCategory.hom a)
lean.note: Retire the Sheaf duplicate in favor of the adopted theorem on strictLocalizationToBase. The former small-model consumer is proved directly from the official set comparison using the canonical small/full colimit isomorphism and the general module section transport theorem. Its public signature is unchanged; no equality of the two scheme presentations is assumed.
